parameters.description: RSQL filter expression, e.g. `name=="Road trip*";track.artist=="Daft Punk"`. Supports ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, =in=, =out=, and `;`/`and`, `,`/`or` combinators, `*` wildcards in string values. Filterable fields: name, title, description, uri, spotifyLink, tidalLink, appleMusicLink, createdAt, updatedAt. The `track.title`, `track.artist`, `track.album` and `track.albumArtist` selectors match the playlist's contents, returning playlists that contain a matching track; several `track.*` terms joined with `;` must all be satisfied by the same track.

schema.description: RSQL filter expression, e.g. `name=="Road trip*";track.artist=="Daft Punk"`. The `track.title`, `track.artist`, `track.album` and `track.albumArtist` selectors match the playlist's contents, returning playlists that contain a matching track; several `track.*` terms joined with `;` must all be satisfied by the same track.
